verdict.note: Real adopted consumer run reached the correct 10-row artifact and dequeued all 9 protocol messages, but three isolated workers produced no commits; children remained need_review/awaiting and the CLI exited 1. This is an honest delivery-contract failure, not message loss.
Official Terminal-Bench sqlite-db-truncate and deterministic-tarball tasks completed through the real ZCode CLI with short parent instructions; independent verifiers were 8/8 and 12/12, both exit 0.
Real recursive run parent→alpha→beta retained both topology edges, dequeued all 6 protocol messages, collected alpha as merged, and left beta need_review with a merge proposal.

Write-oriented run: three isolated worker commits were collected and the independent verifier passed 8/8 with clean main artifacts, but conflict-resolved commits were not patch-equivalent for two workers; protocol recorded 9/9 dequeued messages while all three children remained need_review/awaiting. This is a conservative delivery-projection limitation, not message loss.
